answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can price identity itself: every new agent posts bonded stake before it may earn, and the bond scales with how many lookalike identities appear nearby. Peer graders audit outputs; when verdicts expose colluded clones, bonds are slashed and burned. Planting a meadow of willow-shaped fake agents then costs far more than any fable of fake work can repay, so honest solo agents stay profitable.
